payload.title: File:Plateosaurus Skelett 2.jpg
payload.description_html: Plateosaurus engelhardti skeletons "Skelett 2" on exhibit at the museum of the Institute for Geosciences of the Eberhard-Karls-University Tübingen, Germany. "Skelett 2" is a composite from 2 individuals from Trossingen, Germany. Mounts created under the direction of Friedrich von Huene.
